operation: Update existing PR71 title/body for current tested source and fixed v11 evidence

structuredContent.body:
This draft integrates the four feature PRs while retaining real native Texture/Styles production and original media facts. It adds optional true-directory PVT output and narrows the complete product to arm64/macOS27; three-platform Rust core checks remain. Main and the four original PR tips are unchanged. **Merge and branch deletion remain blocked pending final native gates and parent review.**

Changes:
- Preserve HDR/gain-map relationships, coded/display transforms, RGB16/Main10 values and original primary/video samples. Use typed native skin-carrier selection while rejecting unknown or ambiguous auxiliary graphs.
- Require completed native GPU/edit-state receipts and real source-derived Styles data. Reconstruct HDR before linear-light reduction and preserve the inverse fit.
- Publish pairs/PVT without replacing existing output; retain recoverable complete stages after partial failure. Protect source aliases and opaque packages in CLI, batch checkpoints and App.
- Keep photo+video as the default. The optional PVT directory contains a validated HEIC/MOV pair and metadata.plist with string version1; wrapping adds no encoding. CLI and App share the Rust option.
- Port CLI localization without changing JSON, exit codes or user paths. Pin package dependencies and audit complete native/dylib closure; test relocated arm64 conversion outside the checkout.
- Use one owned consumer boundary for System's three tones and the full eleven-tone sweep. Preserve the fixed upstream extractor/helper import behavior; derive only the pinned iinf parser repair locally. Missing native textures, invalid geometry, incomplete metrics or tool failures cannot yield completed acceptance.
- Adapt scoped pinned pstack instruction skills to existing owners and machine checks. No Cursor bootstrap, new framework or weakened performance threshold.

Current source **91c3ab45310adb05d5e9e3a3d1c23e1345542b06**, tree **56d4dcfd50b29defb99d9d6f3afe0e50c144116b**.

Validation:
- Clean committed-head Linux gate:7/7 pass, including all280 Python tests, workspace all-target clippy/regressions, current CLI build and actual pair/PVT conversion, byte-exact unwrap and duplicate preservation. The Rust command explicitly excludes two repeated JPEG CLI encodes; native product CI retains the full suite.
- Real original pinned extractor/helper/parser integration:42 focused checks pass without skips, including direct-script versus owned-launcher behavior, v1 compatibility and negative import/data cases. These structural tests are not native rendering.
- Previous000 performance job passed unchanged absolute limits: Styles median9.582s/p9512.168s versus11.732/15.406s. Its separate same-runner candidate/main ratio remains1.13288, user11.86/10.58s; the relative cost remains unresolved. Candidate-only nested stages do not prove baseline attribution.
- Current-head native App builds/all30 model calls, System HEIF, complete Tone data, performance, relocated arm64 package and exact-head checks are pending. Old000 product/PVT-path, System-consumer and Tone-import failures remain failed evidence.
- Direct PVT package import is being prepared on an isolated runner-owned environment with synthetic media. No current Photos import, single-Live-Photo pairing or wallpaper success is claimed. Unpacking and creating a PhotoKit pair will not count as package import.

[Fixed v11 evidence, exact-head receipt and26-ref recovery](https://github.com/21Z121Z1/XDRemux/blob/85f3fe05e01e7e0f233e3cea42394f131b585657/docs/validation/reviews/20261020-semantic-integration/iterations/91c3ab4/README.en.md) includes complete first-fault histories and source-bound limits. All26 persistent source refs were independently fetched with exact commit/tree matches, non-shallow full strict fsck0, covering all9 current remote heads. [PVT/App/Texture review and original failures](https://github.com/21Z121Z1/XDRemux/blob/8ebb9c684b0afcd82c7869700ab5745a8dae9359/docs/validation/reviews/20261020-semantic-integration/iterations/000e74b/README.en.md) retain the prior implementation details and earlier dirty-build proofs separately.

After all final gates and recovery review, the proposed convergence is one ordinary merge commit of#71, retaining the original #58/#69/#65/#68 heads as ancestors. Inspect GitHub's actual indirect merged states and automatic source deletion before approving the exact remaining cleanup set. No squash/rebase, merge/delete execution, force push, release, upstream write, paid resource, billing or protection change occurred. No private portrait media are uploaded; native media remain runner-local.
